name: ah
sound: Kurz wie in 'Stadt', lang wie in 'Vater'.
soundEn: Short like the 'u' in 'cut', long like the 'a' in 'father'.

name: beh
sound: Wie im Englischen 'b'. Am Wortende oft wie 'p'.
soundEn: Like English 'b'. At the end of a word it often sounds like 'p'.

name: tseh
sound: Meist wie 'k', vor e/i/ae/oe manchmal wie 'ts'.
soundEn: Usually like 'k'; before e/i/ä/ö sometimes like 'ts'.

name: deh
sound: Wie im Englischen 'd'. Am Wortende wie 't'.
soundEn: Like English 'd'. At the end of a word it sounds like 't'.

name: eh
sound: Kurz wie in 'Bett', lang gedehnt; am Wortende oft ein leiser, geschluckter Laut.
soundEn: Short like the 'e' in 'bed', stretched long; at word endings often a soft, swallowed sound.

name: eff
soundEn: Like English 'f'.

name: geh
sound: Wie das harte englische 'g' in 'go'. Am Wortende wie 'k'.
soundEn: Like the hard English 'g' in 'go'. At the end of a word it sounds like 'k'.

name: hah
sound: Wie im Englischen 'h' - aber nach einem Vokal stumm (siehe Regel unten).
soundEn: Like English 'h' - but silent after a vowel (see the reading rule below).

name: ih
sound: Kurz wie in 'Mitte', lang wie in 'ihr'.
soundEn: Short like the 'i' in 'bit', long like the 'ee' in 'see'.

name: yot
soundEn: Like the English 'y' in 'yes'.

name: kah
soundEn: Like English 'k'.

name: ell
soundEn: Like English 'l'.

name: emm
soundEn: Like English 'm'.

name: enn
soundEn: Like English 'n'.

name: oh
sound: Kurz wie in 'Osten', lang wie in 'oben'.
soundEn: Short like the British 'o' in 'often', long like the 'o' in 'so'.

name: peh
soundEn: Like English 'p'.

name: kuh
soundEn: Always comes with 'u': 'qu' sounds like 'kv'.

name: err
sound: Ein Reibelaut hinten im Rachen - nicht mit der Zungenspitze gerollt (siehe Regel unten).
soundEn: A gargled sound in the back of the throat - not rolled with the tongue tip (see the reading rule below).

name: ess
sound: Am Wortende scharf wie in 'Haus'; vor einem Vokal stimmhaft wie in 'Sommer'.
soundEn: Sharp like the 's' in 'bus' at the end of a word; voiced like the 'z' in 'zoo' before a vowel.

name: teh
soundEn: Like English 't'.

name: uh
sound: Kurz wie in 'und', lang wie in 'Uhr'.
soundEn: Short like the 'u' in 'put', long like the 'oo' in 'moon'.

name: fau
sound: Meist wie 'f'; in manchen Fremdwoertern wie 'w' (siehe Regel unten).
soundEn: Usually like 'f'; in some loanwords like the English 'v' (see the reading rule below).

name: weh
soundEn: Like the English 'v'.

name: iks
soundEn: Like English 'x' (ks).

name: üpsilon
sound: Als Vokal wie 'ü'; in Fremdwoertern manchmal wie das englische 'y'.
soundEn: As a vowel like 'ü'; in loanwords sometimes like the English 'y'.

name: tsett
soundEn: Always 'ts', never a soft 'z'.

name: a-Umlaut
sound: Kurz wie in 'Bett', lang gedehnt - Mund wie bei 'a', aber 'e' sagen.
soundEn: Short like the 'e' in 'bed', stretched long - shape your mouth for 'a' but say 'e'.

name: o-Umlaut
sound: Lippen rund wie bei 'o', aber 'e' sagen.
soundEn: Round your lips as for 'o', but say 'e' - like the vowel in French 'deux'.

name: u-Umlaut
sound: Lippen rund wie bei 'u', aber 'i' sagen.
soundEn: Round your lips as for 'u', but say 'ee' - like the vowel in French 'tu'.

name: Eszett (scharfes S)
sound: Immer scharf wie in 'Haus', nie stimmhaft.
soundEn: Always sharp like the 's' in 'bus', never voiced.

name: ei
soundEn: Like the English word 'eye'.

name: ie
soundEn: A long 'ee', like in the English word 'see'.

name: eu / äu
soundEn: Like 'oy' in the English word 'boy'.

name: au
soundEn: Like 'ow' in the English word 'how'.

name: ch (Ich-Laut / Ach-Laut)
sound: Weich nach e/i/ae/oe/ue (Ich-Laut); hart nach a/o/u (Ach-Laut).
soundEn: Soft after e/i/ä/ö/ü (the 'ich' sound); hard after a/o/u (the 'ach' sound, like Scottish 'loch').

name: sch
soundEn: Like 'sh' in English.

name: sp- am Wortanfang
soundEn: Sounds like 'shp'.

name: st- am Wortanfang
soundEn: Sounds like 'sht'.

name: z
soundEn: Always 'ts', like in the English word 'cats'.

name: s vor einem Vokal
soundEn: Voiced, like the 'z' in the English word 'zoo'.

name: v
soundEn: Like English 'f'.

name: w
soundEn: Like the English 'v'.

name: j
soundEn: Like the English 'y' in 'yes'.

name: h nach einem Vokal
sound: Stumm - dehnt nur den Vokal davor.
soundEn: Silent - it just lengthens the vowel before it.

name: -er am Wortende
soundEn: A weak, swallowed 'a' sound - almost like 'uh'.

name: b/d/g am Wortende
sound: Werden am Wort- oder Silbenende zu 'p/t/k'.
soundEn: Become 'p/t/k' at the end of a word or syllable.

name: r (Rachen-R)
sound: Ein weiches Gurgeln hinten im Rachen, nicht mit der Zungenspitze gerollt.
soundEn: A soft gargle in the back of the throat, not rolled with the tongue tip.
